title: a fetch step's place carries every accurate name, under the citation's own label
line: plan.citation_fields writes a labelled place part as the list a search step's own place field carries, the citation's own string first, unresolved or not; the runner's name-by-name try reads the citation's label as it reads 'place', every name tried logged on the run, the real census connector asked once for the two names, which make the same request, and the second logged as tried with the request it repeated

steps.say: the 1950 census fetch step for Robert Edgar Davidson: the citation's own words, unresolved, are the one string alone

the citation's own words are already a place string of the tree (his own residence claims the same words); the resolver run with the geocoder's real answer planted in its cache, the town of Hempstead and the village in it: it leaves the string to the owner, both offered
the owner chooses the town on the string's card
the plan regenerated: the fetch step's place now carries the citation's own string first, then the place as it resolves

expect.why: the citation's own words lead; the resolved place's own name follows, never dropped for the raw string

steps.say: the runner tries the fetch step's several names under the citation's own label, not 'place', through the real census connector: both names read as county Nassau, state New York: one request goes out and the site answers it with nothing, and the second name, making the same request, is not asked

logged_note.has: Town of Hempstead < Nassau County < New York < United States made the same request as Hempstead, Nassau, New York: not asked again

expect.why: one request goes out, not two (the list is the requests made, and the harness answers one); both names are tried, in order, under the citation's own label, and the note names the name whose request the second repeated

steps.say: a dry run on the same fields: the tried list read back under the citation's own label, not asked blind again

expect.why: the run's tried names, read under 'census place' as the runner wrote them, match the step's own names, the name that made no request among them: the same query again, so the dry run says the connector would not be asked
